gaps.sentence: Critics attacked the film ___ its slow pace.
Don't worry ___ the exam — you're well prepared.
The novel was translated ___ twelve languages.
gaps.explanation: translate FROM one language INTO another.

gaps.sentence: I'm getting bored ___ watching the same series.
The committee does not approve ___ the changes.
gaps.explanation: Verb: approve OF something (noun 'approval' has no preposition).

gaps.sentence: Advertising has a huge influence ___ children.
She had no difficulty ___ finding the station.
gaps.explanation: have difficulty (IN) doing something — 'in' is often omitted, but is the expected preposition.
